title: Selection alone: only the land-capable river species (osprey, hippo, otter, alligator, platypus, saltwater crocodile, beaver, mink, the two snapping turtles) open on the site pool; every fish closed with everything else. These can be placed on any land entry tile, so if none arrives in a season the draw never selects feature entries, whatever the placement rules.
fork: Selection versus placement, the other half.

predictions.model: land-capable river species arrive as ordinary wildlife when eligible
predictions.expects: osprey, hippo or otter arrivals from feature entries within the season

kill_criterion: one arrival from a feature entry settles it
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: land_capable_only
pre: local RIVER={['BIRD_OSPREY']=true,['HIPPO']=true,['RIVER OTTER']=true,['ALLIGATOR']=true,['PLATYPUS']=true,['CROCODILE_SALTWATER']=true,['BEAVER']=true,['MINK']=true,['SNAPPING TURTLE']=true,['ALLIGATOR SNAPPING TURTLE']=true}; local site=df.world_site.find(df.global.plotinfo.site_id); local x0,x1=math.floor(site.global_min_x/16),math.floor(site.global_max_x/16); local y0,y1=math.floor(site.global_min_y/16),math.floor(site.global_max_y/16); local o,c,k,u=0,0,0,0; for _,p in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local r=p.population; if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal then local cr=df.creature_raw.find(p.race); local id=cr and cr.creature_id or ''; local inring=(r.region_x>=x0-1 and r.region_x<=x1+1 and r.region_y>=y0-1 and r.region_y<=y1+1); if RIVER[id] then if p.quantity<50 then p.quantity=50 end; p.flags.extinct=false; o=o+1 elseif inring then if p.quantity_max>=10000000 then u=u+1 end; p.quantity=0; p.flags.extinct=true; c=c+1 else k=k+1 end end end; print(('river whitelist: %d river-species entries open (>=50, any tile, any layer); %d non-river entries on site+ring closed (surface, cavern, feature alike); %d entries beyond the ring left alone; %d of the closed were unbounded (underworld) entries'):format(o,c,k,u))
